We model the baselines using Timeloop and Accelergy [37], which support accelerator architectures and SRAM/-DRAM modeling.

For each architecture, we perform mapping exploration using Timeloop and select the mapping that minimizes EDP under the same optimization criteria and search cost, reporting corresponding performance results.

Since Timeloop does not support modeling multiple pipelined operations, we extract latency from our performance model for generated accelerators and combine it with energy estimates from Accelergy to obtain the final metrics.

All TranSAGE configurations run at 1 GHz using a 45 nm technology model, with parameters summarized in Appendix B. We use DeepScaleTool [43] to scale energy estimates to 8 nm for Orin NX and 7 nm for A100 and Ascend 910B3.
